{"metadata":{"description":"为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除能力，支持侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单入口","id":"gh:1333738556","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-session-cleaner","slug":"fountunt/dsh-session-cleaner","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","session-manager"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话删除能力，支持侧边栏 ⋮ 菜单入口"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-session-cleaner"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from a **running** web runtime — files, live
store, and workspace r"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ecords — without restarting `dsh web`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The official web API only offers `workspace.archiveSession` (hide); there is no
`session.delete`. Th"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"is bundle closes that gap."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then restart `dsh web` (a running instance does not hot-load new bundles)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### Web UI (v1.0.0)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The client half adds a **🗑 "Delete session" item** at the bottom of the
sidebar session row ⋮ menu —"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" the item is skipped when the row title is
ambiguous (duplicate titles)."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Click, confirm, and the session is deleted and the sidebar refreshes. The
item is disabled (greyed) "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"while the session is running; sessions opened in
the UI (idle agents) are stopped first, then delete"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"d. The current running
conversation can never be deleted."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### API"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The plugin registers one route on the web server:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Same-origin calls work from the browser console of the harness page:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Response envelope (mirrors the host's RPC style):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `detached` — the session was removed from the in-memory live store (this is
what makes it disappea"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"r from the sidebar immediately, without a restart).
- `workspaces` — how many workspace records the "},{"id":"p20s3","text":"session was detached from.
- `files` — how many on-disk artifact directories were removed."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Safety"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Sessions with an attached agent (running or idle) are **refused** — the
current conversation can n"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ever be deleted through this endpoint.
- Deletion is irreversible: artifacts, workspace membership, "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"and the live
entry are all removed. The session-projection cache may keep a harmless
stale row until"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" are all removed. The session-projection cache may keep a harmless
stale row until the next restart."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`session.list` is served from the live `SessionStore` plus a disk scan. Cold
sessions get *prepared "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"into the live store* while being listed, so after their
files are deleted they linger as "ghosts" un"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"til the server restarts. This
plugin removes the live entry (the store's own detach path), detaches "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"the
session from workspace records, and deletes the on-disk artifact directory —
so the row disappea"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"rs immediately and permanently."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
